question_text: For each crowd-mode camera_location on 2025-12-08 (UTC), report the average head_count over the full day.
answer_text: On 2025-12-08 (UTC), average head_count by camera_location was: DemoBooth_Intel — 10.648333333333333 (total_samples 86400); DemoBooth_NVIDIA — 15.515 (total_samples 86400); ExpoFloor_MainAisle — 49.35666666666667 (total_samples 86400); FoodCourt_North — 23.069583333333334 (total_samples 86400); KeynoteHall_Stage — 57.3975 (total_samples 86400).

citations.cypher:
MATCH (ch:CrowdHour)-[:AT_CAMERA]->(c:Camera {mode: 'crowd'})
WHERE ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
WITH c.camera_location AS camera_location, sum(ch.avg_hc * ch.event_count) AS weighted_sum, sum(ch.event_count) AS total_samples
WHERE total_samples > 0
RETURN camera_location, toFloat(weighted_sum) / toFloat(total_samples) AS avg_head_count, total_samples
ORDER BY camera_location
